title: One line a human can scan
dataset: D-01 — name AND version, e.g. 'GOOSE 3D val (2024-07 archive)'
sensor_configuration: D-01 — sensors this run actually used, not what the vehicle carries
task_type: see results/README.md for the controlled list
model: name and version or commit — omit for characterisation records
conditions: weather, scenario, time of day, where it matters
commands: the exact commands, in order, sufficient to repeat this

metrics.name: must be defined in docs/metrics-definitions.md first
metrics.scope: which class set, split or range band this number covers

measurements.name: dataset or environment observation, not a model score
measurements.scope: which files, split, machine or run this describes

evidence: repo-relative paths to figures, logs, experiment-log entries
notes: anything a reader needs in order not to over-read the number
_if_not_success: delete this key and fill the four below
error: the EXACT error text, copy-pasted — paraphrased errors are unsearchable
attempted_fixes: what was tried, in order, and what happened after each
blocker: the one thing that stopped it
recommendation: retry with what, change to what, or stop
